annotations.rationale: Both transitions go from increase to the neutral/hold state on a slip-below-threshold guard; guard boundary differs (< vs <=) but purpose matches.
neutral->increase with slp>0.01 matches ref hold->increase with same guard (hold renamed to neutral).
neutral->decrease with slp<-0.01 matches ref hold->decrease with identical guard under hold->neutral renaming.
decrease->neutral with slp>=-0.01 matches ref decrease->hold with identical guard under hold->neutral renaming.
Spurious decrease->increase shortcut with guard slp>0.05 has no equivalent in the ref model.

summary.notes: hold is renamed to neutral throughout pred, yielding four semantic-match TPs; q4 is an extra spurious transition (FP). q0 has a boundary-off guard (< vs <=) but is still treated as a semantic TP at the transition level — the guard discrepancy would be flagged under the guards component_kind.
